name: Regeneration
overview: Regeneration in Scripture is portrayed as a divine work of the heart, where God transforms and inclines it toward Himself, enabling a person to love and obey Him fully. This spiritual renewal is illustrated in God's promise to circumcise the heart so that one may truly live (Deuteronomy 30:6) and is evidenced by the cleansing from sin and restoration of life found in His presence (Psalms 51:2; Psalms 36:9). The change is not merely external but involves God opening eyes and ears to perceive and follow His ways (Deuteronomy 29:4; 1 Kings 8:58), as exemplified in personal encounters such as Jacob’s blessing (Genesis 32:29).
